altJa: 緑褐色の枝分かれした軸に、紫色の丸みのある粒が一粒ずつ付いて房を作るブドウのイラスト。
observationJa: 房全体の輪郭と、一粒ずつの形を見ます。粒の間に見える軸をたどり、枝分かれした部分と粒の付き方も確かめます。
limitJa: 一般的な外観を描いた一例です。粒の色や形には違いがあるため、この図だけで品種、種の有無、熟度、品質や食べられるかどうかを判定しません。

sourceFeatureBoundary.illustrationChoice: 独自の縦長の房。紫色の各粒と、分枝する軸・小果梗の接続が見える構図を新規生成。原写真の横長の房や配置を再現しない。

provenance.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: one original common-appearance fruit recognition illustration for an adult agriculture learning app. Subject: ONE bunch of purple grapes, with clearly separate whole oval-to-spherical berries clustered around an anatomically coherent branching green-brown rachis. A short main stem is visible at the top, with several slender branches connecting individual berry stalks. Make enough of the branch structure visible between berries to show this is a connected bunch, not a pile of unattached spheres. Medium: gentle refined botanical 2D painted illustration with restrained soft shading, matte purple skins, crisp natural silhouettes, calm educational style matching botanical vegetable illustrations. Composition: centered slightly diagonal bunch, complete outline and stem inside generous margins, uniform warm ivory background, modest overlap of berries while maintaining readable individual shapes. No leaves or vine canopy needed. Constraints: entirely new composition, no reference images supplied, no reproduction of any textbook photo or page. No cut fruit, no exposed flesh, no seeds, no eating or ripeness cues, no cultivar labels, no tools, plates, packaging, characters or props. No embedded text, numbers, labels, arrows, logos, border or watermark. This is a single common-appearance example only; do not present color or berry shape as a universal cultivar, ripeness, seedlessness or edibility rule.
provenance.postprocessing: Pillow RGB conversion and aspect-preserving LANCZOS max1024 thumbnail; WebP quality92 method6. No cropping, retouching, compositing, text or geometry edits.

scopeLimits: Limited common-appearance illustration/name matching only; not universal cultivar or photographic identification.
